letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my sweet cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. I cherish how our love dances between skyscrapers and spice markets, turning ordinary moments into golden memories. Today, as the calendar flips gently, I’m reminded how lucky I am to share this adventure with you. Thank you for filling my heart with endless warmth and laughter—forever yours, Tirth.
poem:
In desert dunes and city lights,  
Your love’s the star that guides my nights.  
Through rain-kissed streets of home we roam,  
Together, darling, we are home.
